title: Sparkly bus
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles around the bus -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M10 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 15 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M85 78 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M14 80 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='2.2' fill='#86e3ff'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='46' r='2' fill='#ff9de2'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ff9de2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bus body -->
  <rect x='12' y='32' width='76' height='40' rx='7' fill='#ff5d5d'/>
  <!-- lower stripe -->
  <rect x='12' y='56' width='76' height='9' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- roof highlight -->
  <rect x='16' y='34' width='68' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff8a8a'/>

  <!-- windows -->
  <g fill='#86e3ff'>
    <rect x='17' y='39' width='14' height='13' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='35' y='39' width='14' height='13' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='53' y='39' width='14' height='13' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='71' y='39' width='12' height='13' rx='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <g fill='#d6f7ff'>
    <rect x='18' y='40' width='4' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='36' y='40' width='4' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='54' y='40' width='4' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='72' y='40' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='62' y='55' width='10' height='15' rx='2' fill='#e84545'/>
  <rect x='63.5' y='56.5' width='3' height='12' rx='1' fill='#86e3ff'/>
  <rect x='67.5' y='56.5' width='3' height='12' rx='1' fill='#86e3ff'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='8' fill='#3a3550'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='3.5' fill='#c9c3e0'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='73' r='8' fill='#3a3550'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='73' r='3.5' fill='#c9c3e0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
